note: Map fills derived from flag hues. Hue is the flag's dominant hue, unmodified. Lightness is one of four graph-coloured tiers so that no two bordering countries share a fill -- a small hue nudge cannot achieve that at low chroma (see scripts/build-map-palette.mjs). Lightness carries NO value meaning.
